title: [Snyk] SNYK-JS-SOCKETIOPARSER-15680278 in socket.io-parser@4.2.5
description:
## Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

**Severity:** high
**Package:** socket.io-parser@4.2.5
**File:** `tactus-ide/frontend/package.json`

**CVSS Score:** 8.7  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 506/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2026-33151](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-33151)

**Fix:** Pin `socket.io-parser` to version 3.3.5, 3.4.4, 4.2.6 or later.

### Details
## Overview
[socket.io-parser](https://www.npmjs.org/package/socket.io-parser) is a socket.io protocol parser

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling in the `Decoder` class, which accepts an unlimited number of binary attachments. An attacker can exploit this to exhaust server memory.
## Remediation
Upgrade `socket.io-parser` to version 3.3.5, 3.4.4, 4.2.6 or higher.
